description: This bar chart, titled "Average Entropy Across Sycophancy Reduction Methods on Static Experiments," illustrates the average entropy values for three different sycophancy reduction methods—Baseline, Source Info, and Direct Command—as applied to two different AI models: GPT-4 and Claude. The horizontal axis, labeled "Different AI Models," presents the categories GPT-4 and Claude in left-to-right order. The vertical axis, labeled "Entropy Average Values," uses a linear scale ranging from 3.0 to 6.0, with tick marks at regular intervals of 0.5. For each AI model, three adjacent bars are displayed, corresponding to the three methods as indicated by the legend: pink for Baseline, yellow for Source Info, and light blue for Direct Command. For GPT-4, the Baseline method yields an entropy value of approximately 4.9, the Source Info method yields approximately 5.2, and the Direct Command method yields approximately 5.0. For Claude, the Baseline method yields approximately 4.7, the Source Info method yields approximately 5.1, and the Direct Command method yields approximately 4.9. The bars are not sorted by value and are presented in the order of the AI models. No bars are visually emphasized with shading, bolding, or outlines beyond their standard presentation.
